text_block_list.text:
One day, I came across Tap Dance City and her friend
having a serious conversation.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Study abroad for language? ...Why would ya do that?
Can't you study English here in Japan?

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but... I feel like there are things
you just can't understand unless you experience the local air firsthand!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
...Don't make that face, Tap.
It's only for half a year. Once my study abroad ends,
I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I know. If you didn't plan on comin' back,
I would've held you back right then and there.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...It's not goodbye forever. Just "see ya later" for half a year.
Even so, damn it all............ Darn it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Nah, no more moping around, that ain't like me.
—Let's throw a send-off party for her!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! You heard the whole thing, right?
Give me some advice while you're at it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
What kind of banquet would fire her up—
and give her that extra push?

A banquet that gives her a push... If we want to throw a party
that encourages her on her study abroad—
choice_data_list: Let's go all out and make it flashy!
Let's make it a familiar, everyday kind of party!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Now that sounds great!
That way, there won't even be time for tears!
It's gonna be one hell of a lively banquet!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the party!
Let the wild, extravagant banquet begin!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
Throwing a party at a place like this!?
Ahaha! This is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Overalls-Wearing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way! There's a pool here~!
And all this food looks insanely good too~!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hold your horses, we haven't even done the opening ceremony yet!
—Guest of honor! Give us a toast!
I'm parched to death over here!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah! ...Everyone got their glasses?
Alright then, umm—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: To our comrade's glorious voyage, cheers!

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
Wha... Tap—!
Weren't you gonna let me do the toast!?—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cool! That was the absolute best dance! Man,
you've really honed your craft! Color me impressed!

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next up is Tap. Our leader's gonna show off
something even more incredible than usual, right?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my turn? Actually, I've got a tale
I'd like to recite like a poet... Stage open?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—This is the story of a certain girl.
Up until now, that girl had lived her life aimlessly.
Fun, ordinary, and without direction.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
But one day, an intriguing horse girl broke into her world.
—That horse girl loudly declared
that her dream was to build a castle.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"What? A castle? Don't be ridiculous!
There's no way you could ever earn that kind of fortune!"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—That's what she thought only at first.
As the girl watched the horse girl, she thought,
"Maybe this one could actually pull it off."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
..."Then what about me?"
"Is having no ridiculous dreams like hers ordinary, but the right way to be?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I want to find out... Do I really have no dreams of my own?"
Pondering this, the girl made up her mind to embark on a journey—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Her destination: the birthplace of the horse girl who spoke of grand ambitions
—America. To find her dream there,
the girl sets off on her travels!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
...I never told you the reason I was going to study abroad, Tap!?
How in the world do you know that!?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Our friends told me!
—When I heard about it, I was super happy!
Not because I influenced you, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
It's because you acknowledged my dream.
...So, let me say one thing to you too.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—There's always a place for you in my castle.
No matter where you go, never forget that.

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text: Tap... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
See ya later, my dearest friend.
Don't stay away too long.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But then,
it won't feel like a special party, will it?
choice_data_list: "Business as usual" is what makes it special.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Huh. I like that.
Never crossed my mind.
Thanks for the tip!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the party!
Come on, let's fool around just like always!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Alright, let's party hard today—!

text_block_list.name: Overalls-Wearing Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, you studying abroad makes me super lonely~.
Hey, hey. Can't you reconsider?

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Don't try to hold back someone who's made up her mind.
We decided we'd send her off with a smile, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text: Hehe... Everyone, thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Stop it! No gettin' all sappy!
Let's start the same fun, lively banquet as always!!

text_block_list.name: Friends
text_block_list.text: Ooooh—!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Cool! That was the absolute best dance! Man,
you've really honed your craft! Color me impressed!

something even more incredible than usual, right?

Some time later, just like before,
I ran into Tap Dance City and her friend.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hey there, Trainer!
Thanks for the advice the other day!
Thanks to you, we threw an awesome banquet!

text_block_list.name: Woman Studying Abroad
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I still have half a year before I leave,
so it was a bit early for a farewell party, though.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Details, details!
Besides, this means we get to throw one more party before you study abroad!
